description: T1 item 1 design sources: every committed RTL file under design/rtl/ (the tile, its slice, and the routed/switch-matrix variants, so an edit to any of them turns the row stale) plus the derived generic-cell netlist, whose freshness command regenerates it from the RTL with yosys and diffs it. The freshness command needs yosys, which the signoff CI runner lacks, so it is local_only: CI --check carries the committed outcome and re-hashes every file. Re-run the attest command in signoff/README.md after an RTL change.
